tasks.label: Prepare Mugen Matrix video project
args:
cp -R /Users/towasakurada/.agents/skills/launch-video-craft/kit video/mugen-matrix-launch && printf '
video/mugen-matrix-launch/
video/mugen-matrix-launch.mp4
' >> .git/info/exclude && cd video/mugen-matrix-launch && npm install && npm run sync

tasks.label: Install video dependencies and sync kit
args: cd video/mugen-matrix-launch && npm install && npm run sync

tasks.label: Link footage and validate promo code
args: cd video/mugen-matrix-launch && mkdir -p public/audio && ln -s ../../playing.MP4 public/playing.MP4 && ln -s ../../tutorial.MP4 public/tutorial.MP4 && ln -s ../../ranking.MP4 public/ranking.MP4 && cp ../../LinearPractice/Assets.xcassets/InfinityMatrix.imageset/infiinty_matrix_2.png public/matrix-logo.png && npm run audio && npm run typecheck

tasks.label: Install audio generator dependency
args: python3 -m pip install numpy && cd video/mugen-matrix-launch && npm run audio && npm run typecheck

tasks.label: Typecheck and verify film stills
args: cd video/mugen-matrix-launch && npm run typecheck && npm run verify

tasks.label: Copy footage and rerun verification
args: cd video/mugen-matrix-launch && rm public/playing.MP4 public/tutorial.MP4 public/ranking.MP4 && cp ../../playing.MP4 ../../tutorial.MP4 ../../ranking.MP4 public/ && npm run verify

tasks.label: Copy assets and verify again
args: cd video/mugen-matrix-launch && cp ../playing.MP4 ../tutorial.MP4 ../ranking.MP4 public/ && npm run verify

tasks.label: Recheck type safety and film stills
args: cd video/mugen-matrix-launch && npm run typecheck && npm run verify

tasks.label: Final still verification before render
args: cd video/mugen-matrix-launch && npm run typecheck && npm run verify && df -h ../..

tasks.label: Inspect generated render cache sizes
args: df -h .; du -sh video/mugen-matrix-launch/node_modules video/mugen-matrix-launch/review video/mugen-matrix-launch/public ~/.npm 2>/dev/null; find /var/folders/ms/lf1rrpfx6c7b9ghmwpv5sws80000gn/T -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'remotion-webpack-bundle-*' -print; find /var/folders/ms/lf1rrpfx6c7b9ghmwpv5sws80000gn/T -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'remotion-webpack-bundle-*' -exec du -sh {} \;
